notes.title: Night Of The Dead is approaching!

tags.balance_change: - Islands of The Dead now spawn more frequently;
- There's a chance for undead monsters to appear on every type of islands and dungeons;
- God of The Dead is now less less angry when you apply any healing;

notes.title: Update 1.1 is now live!

tags.feature: 3 new buildings and NPCs added to Pirate Island - mostly merchants with unique set of items;
Ship is redrawn, now has the hold, where you can find few useful objects;
Sea is not empty anymore! 3 types of ships are stranding across the ocean, and most of all - they are hostile to you! And dont forget about deadly tornados!
If you sail too close to an enemy ship, you will be engaged with boarding battle. Use cannons to destroy invaders!

Dungeons are now filled with new type of quest-objects. They require certain item to be opened/cleansed etc., but can be used with bare hands as well. I don't guarantee a successful result of such action!
6 new abilities added, few old abilities reworked, mostly to increase the impact of support-like characters;
You can now save game anywhere, exept in combat!

tags.balance_change: Balance/economy changes. Now you lose crewmates even in Normal mode, but dying with all crew would just rewind you to previous save;

notes.title: Roadmap

tags.feature: At least 4 new monsters for each island type ;
More spells, divided by power and utility;
Random storylines inside a playthrough;
Day/Night cycle;
Weather events across global map;
Activity on pirate island (quest buildings, NPCs, shops, even dungeons);
Procedurally generated quests;
Activity on ship and while traveling;
Character visual customization (gender, skin, cloth etc.);
Additional classes with more unique playstyle;
Better dungeon environment;
Interier compositions on islands and inside dungeons;
Gamepad support;
Multiple screen resolution support;
Binding playthrough to a seed;
Possibility to save the game everywhere except in combat;
Transfer client achivements to Steam;
